comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. Param 4 (LED BACKLIGHT) has no widget and no census position, so it gets no line: it is set by the module rather than turned. The M key is GLFW key 77 and the L key 76, both handled in the knob and button hover-key handlers; a knob takes only M. The MIDI menu headings print MIDI Devices - Slot N for a helper with a MIDI output and MIDI Inputs - Slot N for one without.
